right.desc: Divert resources to make more food.
Cut down on power usage to other systems.

left.desc: We can't risk lowering our defences.

main_003.desc: NASA's lost VIPER rover rolls up to our Mons Mouton airlock, headlights flashing! Its Earth X-band link is dead, and its Neutron Spectrometer is pinging nearby.

right.desc: Sync it to our comms and send it into a 50-hour Permanently Shadowed Region (PSR) sortie for water-ice!

left.desc: Deploy it to Shackleton's illuminated rim as a solar bank and Lunar Flashlight relay.

alien_001_dip.desc: An alien delegation approaches the perimeter, broadcasting a peaceful mathematical sequence.

alien_001_com.desc: Alien vessels lock weapons onto our primary dome! Our refusal to share resources has provoked an attack.

rover_001_ice.desc: VIPER's wheels have sunk into high-porosity 'fairy-castle' regolith inside a dark micro-crater! Conventional spinning will bury its chassis to the belly pan.

right.desc: Engage VIPER's active suspension: lift and 'swim' each wheel forward using the Inchworm gait.

left.desc: Fire emergency colony winches and drag it up the crater wall to the sunlit ridge!

rover_001_scout.desc: The rover clipped a boulder and tore off a rear fender! Razor-sharp, electrostatically levitated lunar dust is coating its optical solar reflectors, spiking thermal load.

right.desc: Execute Apollo 17's Gene Cernan fix: clamp laminated colony EVA maps to the wheel well!

left.desc: Order it down into a 40K (-233°C) shadow trap to dump excess heat before its avionics melt.

rover_002_ice.desc: At 38 Kelvin inside the PSR, the TRIDENT rotary-percussive drill hits cemented ice at 0.8m! Auger torque is spiking, and battery survival heaters have 4 hours left.

right.desc: Run the TRIDENT 'bite-and-brush' cycle: retract every 10cm to analyze cuttings with MSolo and warm the bit.

left.desc: Jettison the stuck drill string and sprint for a 'Safe Haven' sunlit ridge before battery death!

rover_002_scout.desc: Red alert! NASA's DONKI network detects an X-class Coronal Mass Ejection. High-energy protons will cause single-event upsets in the rover's RAD750 flight computer!

right.desc: Command 'Safe Mode': park behind anorthosite megaboulders and power down non-essential buses.

left.desc: Dive down the steep regolith chute into the crater basin to use the crater rim as a radiation shield!

rover_003_ice.desc: Success! NIRVSS and MSolo confirm 5% water-ice by weight alongside trapped ammonia and CO2 volatiles! VIPER hauls a full core load back to our ISRU plant.

right.desc: Sublimate the cores for our hydroponic bays and scrub the ammonia into plant fertilizer!

left.desc: Run Sabatier electrolysis: split the H2O into breathable O2 and methalox fuel for colony reserves.

rover_003_scout.desc: VIPER mapped Connecting Ridge's 'Peak of Eternal Light' (92% annual illumination) and located high-titanium ilmenite deposits along the rim!

right.desc: Anchor a vertical solar array on the peak and beam microwave power straight to our habitat grid!

left.desc: Microwave-sinter the ilmenite regolith into radiation-shielding bricks for our colony domes.
